title: Hinomori Shiho — Looking Up At The Stars〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Nicely done, girls. That was a wonderful performance.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah. I'd say that was your best today, no?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's true that we managed to play as if it were the real deal. Didn't make any noticeable mistakes either.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I agree. Let's go through it again at that same level.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh...? The door's ajar. I know we closed it when we started practice...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, you're right. Should we shut it?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'll do that. You girls continue your practice.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Thanks, Luka.
Alright, from the top...
Hold on! Don't close the door, please!
Ohhh... This door's so heavy, I can't open it any further.
I'll just have to squeeze through the gap...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh my...
Hnng, hnng...!
Phew... Great! I thought I wouldn't fit.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Wh...What am I looking at...?!)

rows.Speaker: Mimitchi
rows.Line: I'm Mimitchi! It's nice to meet you!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Y-You're so cu—!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wait, no! Who are you?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So, to sum up what you told us, Mimitchi...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You attend Tamagotchi School on Tamagotchi Planet...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And when you and your friends were having trouble with choir practice, one of them made you each a sleep-learning machine.

rows.Speaker: Mimitchi
rows.Line: Yup!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Your friend must be pretty amazing.
Kamishiro sprung to mind.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Then, when you went to sleep with the machine turned on, you heard a band performance instead of the choir song you were assigned...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You wanted to hear more because of how cool it sounded, and before you knew it, you were standing in front of that door... Did I understand that all correctly?

rows.Speaker: Mimitchi
rows.Line: Wowee, Honami! You made my story so easy to understand!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Heh heh heh. This is Hona we're talking about!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And why are you the one gloating...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So, Mimitchi, right?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Your name is too cute...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (...! The way you gesture...!)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Um... Do you know how to get back?

rows.Speaker: Mimitchi
rows.Line: Nope, not at all. But...

rows.Speaker: Mimitchi
rows.Line: I'm pretty sure the sleep-learning machine is showing me a dream right now.

rows.Speaker: Mimitchi
rows.Line: So, I'll wake up in the morning and everything'll be back to normal!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That would mean the Mimitchi we see here is actually just your consciousness or your spirit.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?! You mean we're looking at an astral projection?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: We can't deny the possibility...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: However it all works, I'm glad you've got a way back.

rows.Speaker: Mimitchi
rows.Line: Thanks! It's so nice of you to worry about me, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh? Oh... No problem...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (No way... You're too cute...!)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (What do those ears and cheeks feel like? Would they be fluffy, or more squishy?)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I-I wanna know...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (But asking to feel them all of a sudden would be rude...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey, Mimitchi! Now that we're introduced, let's shake hands to make our friendship official♪

rows.Speaker: Mimitchi
rows.Line: Sure thing! Let's shake!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Great! Shakey shake!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We'd like that too.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You're up next, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, um, right...

rows.Speaker: Mimitchi
rows.Line: We're pals now, Shiho! Thanks for being my friend!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah... Same here.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (S-So soft. It feels like I'm touching a plushie...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, I know...!
Shiho, why don't you pick Mimitchi up?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh? Wh-Why would I do that?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I mean, even standing on top of a desk, our little friend still has to look up at us, y'know?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I was just thinking, it must be really uncomfortable constantly looking up like that.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I thought it was weird when she suddenly asked for a handshake...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I don't need any of your funny ideas...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huuuh? Whatever do you meeean?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Geez...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So, Mimitchi, what are you going to do now?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, you probably won't be able to go back until it's morning on Tamagotchi Planet and you wake up, right?

rows.Speaker: Mimitchi
rows.Line: Yup! So, I wanna stay here for a while.

rows.Speaker: Mimitchi
rows.Line: And...

rows.Speaker: Mimitchi
rows.Line: It'd be great if you could all teach me how to sing!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What? How to sing?

rows.Speaker: Mimitchi
rows.Line: I wanna learn to sing that song better for our recital!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Now that you mention it, you did say none of your attempts went well...

rows.Speaker: Mimitchi
rows.Line: That's why I wanna know how I'm supposed to sing, and how to be in sync with everyone!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What do you all think? We're in the middle of our practice, but...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Let's help! I mean, Mimitchi came all this way listening to us perform.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'd also like it if we could help.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We can practice another time, but this may be our only chance to teach Mimitchi what we know.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Well, we did do well on that last performance... I guess we could call the rest of our practice off for now.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Mimitchi... We'll help you with your singing.

rows.Speaker: Mimitchi
rows.Line: Thank you! I'm ready to learn!
